title: Regine Velasquez’s son, nephews, nieces take spotlight at ‘Finale’ concert
summary: While Regine Velasquez’s recently-concluded three-night concert celebrated her musicality, the sold-out shows also put a spotlight on her son Nate, and her nephews and nieces who performed with her.…

blocks.text: While Regine Velasquez’s recently-concluded three-night concert celebrated her musicality, the sold-out shows also put a spotlight on her son Nate, and her nephews and nieces who performed with her. Nate and his band called Meet Me At The Elevator were special guests at the her “Finale” concert, where they performed “The Easy Kind,” with the Asia’s Songbird. The song is a track from Velasquez’s “Golden Hours” album that was released on October 17, coinciding with her “Finale” concert series.
